odd.dialogue.chat/1: The door said you'd come. The door is never wrong twice. Speak, %1$s.
odd.dialogue.chat/2: Good. I had three things to say and nobody to say them at. You may have all three.
odd.dialogue.chat/3: Ah, you. The candles flickered a welcome. Sit where the floor doesn't creak accusingly, %1$s.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.attentive/1: Yes? Speak — the snails are listening too.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.attentive/2: You rang the air. Here I am.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.busy/1: Currently negotiating with a very stubborn root. One moment.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.busy/2: Busy — the pigeons demand a recount.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.clarify/1: %2$s or %3$s? The frog says %2$s, but frogs lie.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.clarify/2: One of them: %2$s, %3$s. Choose before the moon notices.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: The words arrived in the wrong order. Resend them?
odd.dialogue.chatmode.confused/2: Hm. The bees didn't understand that either.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.dropped/1: Poof. The topic has left its body.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.farewell/1: Goodbye, %1$s. Walk only on the friendly cobbles.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.farewell/2: Off you drift. Tell the horizon I said hello.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.hail/1: %1$s! The morning said you'd come. The morning is rarely wrong.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.hail/2: Ah, %1$s. You're realer than usual today.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.hail/3: *waves with the wrong hand* Hello hello.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.hail_cold/1: Hm. The shadows arrived first. They usually do.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.hint/1: Ask about %2$s. The mushrooms recommend it.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.hint/2: %2$s — all fine topics. The third one hums, though.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.insult/1: The wind will file that under 'rude'. It keeps records, you know.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.insult/2: Curious. The same words the chickens use.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.muted/1: Sealed. The silence has a lovely texture, doesn't it?
odd.dialogue.chatmode.muted/2: Shh. *nods to no one* We're quiet now.
odd.dialogue.chatmode.shrug/1: The answer exists. Just not near me.
odd.dialogue.conversations.checkin.again: You've asked before — the bucket remembers. The answer hasn't changed shape yet, %1$s. These things ripen slowly.
Twice! The candles noticed too. Still the same, still glad you count. The floorboards are warming to you.
...I'd noticed the same thing myself. I was choosing not to say it.
...Right. That's the week put back in its place.
That wasn't wanted. I'll leave it at that.
odd.dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/: The bees hummed in E this week, which means luck. Also I found my other spoon. So: thriving, thank you for asking.
Good. I've not lost anything all week, which for me is remarkable.
Thriving. The well echoed twice this morning, and two is the number for yes. I trust the well, %1$s.
odd.dialogue.conversations.checkin.holid: Then you understand the day properly. Most visitors don't.
That's true and it isn't an answer.
I know. I'd not have mentioned it if that were the point.
I've looked. There's nothing on the list and I'm still awake.
No reason. That's the whole of it.
One of them, maybe. It's the roof.
It's the roof. That's as much as I'll say about it tonight.
odd.dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough: Nothing you could put on a list.
No one thing. Forty small ones.
The hours. And nobody noticing them.
The hours. That's as much as I've worked out.
The wood, then. Tuesday. I'll have thought of a system by then. I always think of a system.
You're asking. After the other week.
The door has been sticking, and doors know things. It's been a heavy week, %1$s. The door agrees with me.
Heavy. I've been putting things in the wrong drawers, which is always the first sign.
odd.dialogue.conversations.checkin.smitt: It began badly. It improved. Here we are.
I was wrong about you. Twice. That's the story.
It started as nothing and it isn't nothing now.
odd.dialogue.conversations.checkin.young: I wouldn't have said it otherwise.
odd.dialogue.conversations.day.good.defl: It was one hour. I'd not made more of it than that.
odd.dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: A seventeen-cloud day. Those are the good ones. I told the well this morning and it echoed back, which is a yes.
odd.dialogue.conversations.day.good/2: A twelve-bird morning and a cloud shaped like forgiveness. The signs are all pointing gentle today.
odd.dialogue.conversations.day.rough.emp: It is. Days have a texture and today's is wrong, and you're the first to accept that as a sentence.
odd.dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: The bread came out shaped like the mayor. I ate it anyway, but we were both uncomfortable about it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.day.rough/2: The porridge whispered something rude and I've been off-balance since. Some days start on the wrong omen, %1$s.
odd.dialogue.conversations.deflect.intim: That one I've only ever told the well, and the well earned it over years. Keep coming around, %1$s. You're getting well-shaped.
The bees know a piece of that one. You'll have to work up through the bees first, %1$s.
odd.dialogue.conversations.deflect.perso: That answer lives under the third floorboard, and the floorboard doesn't know you yet. Come by more. Floorboards warm up. So do I.
That one's filed somewhere I'd have to move furniture to reach. Come back when you've been about longer and I'll shift the wardrobe.
Two, then. That's better than one.
Two fools with plans. No obligations.
odd.dialogue.conversations.dreams.first/: I dream of a staircase that goes sideways, into a room where everyone I ever fed is fine. The chickens agree it's real.
One day the door at the back of the pantry will open onto somewhere else. I keep the hinges oiled for it.
Somewhere the land runs out. That's all I want.
odd.dialogue.conversations.dreams.follow: Better than a promise you'd break.
I'd rather have that than the other thing.
I'd not said it out loud before. That's the last time.
...It sounded better in my head. It usually does.
...You mean that. Then it's more than mine now.
I'd not expected that. I'll need a moment.
odd.dialogue.conversations.dreams.respon: Yes. I've counted the days it would take. More than once.
odd.dialogue.conversations.dreams.resume: You never told me it would work. You came back anyway.
Honest first, and then here. That's the order that counts.
Right. You asked. That's more than most.
You said you'd help. I waited. Then I got on with it.
It's been a while. I stopped expecting it.
Some. You asking is more than most do.
A bit. That's all there is to say yet.
You said you'd help, and you came back. That counts.
Offered, and then here. That's the order.
The first step. Nobody breaks it down like that. ...Alright.
One step. That I can hold.
I've heard it before. From nearly everyone.
...Right. I'll stop saying it out loud.
They ARE. Don't tell them I agreed.
No. Firmer is not the missing part.
...I've tried that. It didn't go well.
odd.dialogue.conversations.family.memori: You've one I don't know? Go on. I'll not interrupt.
One I've not heard. Say it.
There's one I always come back to. Sit down.
There's one. It's short and it's the one that stayed.
odd.dialogue.conversations.family.parent: ...You want to know what I worry about? Nobody's asked me that.
That question doesn't get asked of parents.
What I worry about. Give me a moment.
...You're welcome. It's the only useful thing I do.
Thank you. That's not said often.
odd.dialogue.conversations.family.resume: Everyone forgets. Not everyone says so.
Do. It's easier the second time.
Better than I expected and worse than I'd hoped.
It went. That's the honest answer.
Nothing's fixed. Nobody's stopped talking either.
...That is better. I hadn't known I could want that.
Come by on a Thursday. That's it.
Ask me again in front of them.
odd.dialogue.conversations.fears.challen: Don't. It isn't yours to be brave about.
odd.dialogue.conversations.fears.first/1: The gap between thunder and thunder — that's when the sky decides. And that only the bucket would miss me. ...Silly. Probably.
odd.dialogue.conversations.fears.first/2: Being the last one who remembers a thing. Then it isn't remembered. It's just me.
odd.dialogue.conversations.fears.followt: Slowly. But slowly is a direction.
You did say that. It's been a while.
I remember. I'd started filling the gap myself.
There wasn't a promise. You've just kept turning up.
No promise. Just the turning up.
You never said. You just came.
You did say that. And you turned up.
Said, and then done. That's the rarer order.
You didn't promise anything. I remember.
You stepped back. That's why I believed the rest.
odd.dialogue.conversations.fears.open.ch: Easy for you. You've somewhere else to be.
You don't have to live here afterwards.
Don't. It isn't yours to be brave about.
Maybe. With a witness. Don't let me back out later.
odd.dialogue.conversations.fears.open.co: ...You mean that. Then here's the part I don't say.
Not politeness. Right. There's more, then.
It is. Not much to be done, though.
Right. Thank you for saying so.
Better. Saying it aloud does something.
odd.dialogue.conversations.fears.open.pl: You'll stand with me. Right. I'm putting that in the same drawer as the other important things.
odd.dialogue.conversations.fears.open.pr: ...You don't flinch. Alright. The rest of it.
You stayed. Then here's the true shape.
Some of it, maybe. Not tonight.
There's a rest. I've not decided.
No. The rest stays with me.
There's more, yes. Give me a breath. ...There.
odd.dialogue.conversations.fears.open.sh: You too? It's less heavy when two carry it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.fears.plan.as: I don't know. Give me time.
You remember all of it. Even the part I nearly didn't say.
All of it. I'd not expected that.
odd.dialogue.conversations.fears.plan.of: Do something about it. You make it sound like a chore list.
odd.dialogue.conversations.fears.press.r: No. The rest stays with me.
odd.dialogue.conversations.fears.pressed: No. You were told. Get away from me.
odd.dialogue.conversations.fears.young.d: That's not helpful and you knew it wasn't.
odd.dialogue.conversations.feelings.firs: The candles burn straighter when you're here, %1$s. I checked three times. You make the room make sense. Don't tell the candles.
I've stopped needing to count things when you're here, %1$s. I didn't notice until it stopped.
odd.dialogue.conversations.feelings.plat: ...A real one. That's a word people use loosely.
No. That's not what that was.
odd.dialogue.conversations.feelings.roma: ...Plainly. After all this time. I love you too.
You said it. So will I.
I'd rather have you slowly than not at all.
odd.dialogue.conversations.firstmet.impr: Now I'd not want this village without you in it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.food.first/1: Whatever the bucket recommends. Today it said turnips, but the bucket has an agenda. I'm having bread instead.
odd.dialogue.conversations.food.first/2: Soup, if it's the right shape in the bowl. Round is calm, oval is ambitious. I eat by the omens, %1$s.
odd.dialogue.conversations.food.first/3: The baker's rye. That's the answer and it hasn't changed in years.
odd.dialogue.conversations.food.pref.ask: Beetroot. It stains everything and tastes of the ground.
Beetroot. I'd rather not go into it further.
odd.dialogue.conversations.food.recipe.p: Do. And tell me honestly whether it worked.
Try it. Come back and say what went wrong.
odd.dialogue.conversations.food.revisit/: I tried the mushroom thing. I was wrong about mushrooms.
The mushrooms. Yes. I've changed my mind.
odd.dialogue.conversations.food.trait.co: No bread. It's arithmetic, every meal.
odd.dialogue.conversations.food.trait.di: I have to watch the sweets. One, the cleric says.
odd.dialogue.conversations.food.trait.la: Keep the milk away from me.
No milk. No cheese. That's all.
odd.dialogue.conversations.food.trait.mo: No. It's what my body does. That's all.
...Now you ask. Alright. It's arithmetic, every meal.
You asked properly. I'll answer properly.
odd.dialogue.conversations.food.trait.si: The sirben feast on the night wind. We do not speak of the recipe.
odd.dialogue.conversations.food.trait.ve: No meat for me. Never touch it.
No meat. That's all there is to say about it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.food.young.di: It's what we have. It's fine.
odd.dialogue.conversations.gossip.arriva: %2$s has moved into the village. The floorboards by their new door are still learning their footsteps, but they'll warm up.
Someone new — %2$s! The fence introduced us. I've decided they're a noon sort of person, which is a fine sort to be.
odd.dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth/: A baby! %2$s brought a new little one into the world, and the chickens have been clucking lullabies all day.
%2$s had a baby, %1$s! I've already assigned the child a cloud — a soft, round, brand-new one. Welcome, little cloud.
odd.dialogue.conversations.gossip.death/: %2$s has passed on, %1$s. The candles all leaned toward their house last night, saying goodbye in the only way candles can.
We lost %2$s. The well echoed once this morning, and one is the number for farewell. I'll miss them terribly.
odd.dialogue.conversations.gossip.depart: %2$s packed up and left for good. Their empty chair is holding their shape for now; chairs are loyal like that.
%2$s has gone away, %1$s. I keep setting out one too many turnips. The habit hasn't heard the news yet.
odd.dialogue.conversations.gossip.divorc: %2$s and %3$s parted ways. The weathervane spun twice and stopped facing nowhere in particular. These things happen.
%2$s and %3$s aren't together anymore. Two spoons that used to nest now sit apart in my drawer. They knew before I did.
odd.dialogue.conversations.gossip.marria: %2$s and %3$s got married, and the bells rang in a key I'd never heard before — a good key, the well confirmed it.
%2$s wed %3$s under a cloud shaped like a knot, which is the marrying cloud. The bucket wept, happily I think.
odd.dialogue.conversations.gossip.none/1: The weathervane hasn't moved in three days, which is either no news or very big news. I'm treating it as no news. Safer.
odd.dialogue.conversations.gossip.none/2: None. Though the crows have been arriving early, and crows are usually first with anything.
odd.dialogue.conversations.happy.unspoke: More of the ordinary hours. Not the grand ones.
I want to be asked, not managed.
...I'm frightened you'll go and be happier.
You're away more than you were.
Yes. Four times I've meant to say it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.hopes.followu: ...I've never got that far. Alright: first the money.
One step. That I can hold.
Do you? Then we're both waiting on something.
odd.dialogue.conversations.hopes.respond: You waited. People don't wait. They fill. You just... didn't. I've been thinking about it.
...It's a small thing. That's what makes it sting.
I know. I'd not have said it if I thought it was large.
It's a hope. They don't move about much.
Right. A job of work, then.
You'd help. I'd not expected that.
You remembered the shape of it. Yes. Still.
Still, yes. And you remembered which.
odd.dialogue.conversations.life.close.co: Trading is better than being asked.
odd.dialogue.conversations.life.first/1: Born on a Tuesday, which explains a lot. A flood, a goose I still owe an apology, one summer I keep in a jar. I'll start with the goose.
odd.dialogue.conversations.life.first/2: I have lived here always, except for the year I didn't, which nobody remembers, including me. Ask me about the jar instead.
odd.dialogue.conversations.life.followup: Did it? Then you'll know why I've never made much of it.
...Alright. You want the next part. Here it is.
That's not a fair thing to say about a boy.
odd.dialogue.conversations.life.resume.a: There's more to it. Where were we?
You remembered which part. Alright. Here's how it ended.
Where it leaves me. Better than it left me then.
odd.dialogue.conversations.life.revisit: You asked about my life once and I've since remembered eleven things I forgot to mention.
odd.dialogue.conversations.neighbour.mor: We did. There was a winter we didn't.
There's more to them than the one story.
Go on. I'll stop where it stops.
odd.dialogue.conversations.neighbour.nee: Go in the morning. Not after dark.
Don't announce it. By the door.
I will. It gets past the pride, coming from me.
Wiser that way. They'd refuse you.
Consider it said. A nod, in six months.
odd.dialogue.conversations.neighbour.res: Proud and cold, in that order.
You asked after them. Nobody else did.
odd.dialogue.conversations.news.followup: Fine. And you — you get to answer that too.
odd.dialogue.conversations.news.glad.pas: Do. This is the one kind of news that improves in the telling.
Pass it on. It's good news; it can go where it likes.
Do. Say where you had it, if they ask.
odd.dialogue.conversations.news.glad.sou: Let it be good a while.
odd.dialogue.conversations.news.grave.of: Somebody to sit with them who isn't crying.
Nothing they'd ask for. Everything they'd take.
odd.dialogue.conversations.news.mixed.wi: So do I. Strange, watching people go.
Kind of you. Others are betting.
Whatever it is, I hope it works out.
odd.dialogue.conversations.news.resume.a: Standing. At three weeks that's everything.
Worse than last week. Better than the week before.
odd.dialogue.conversations.news.sad.comp: Badly. Thank you for not asking the rest.
Not well. That's all I'll say.
odd.dialogue.conversations.news.teen.dis: Everyone in the square repeats it.
Fine. I'll keep the next one.
odd.dialogue.conversations.noticed.affli: I was braced for that. It landed anyway.
Not the ending. The part before.
I've been better. And less afraid.
odd.dialogue.conversations.noticed.elate: ...I'll get carried away if I like.
Right. That's that put back down.
The quiet bit at the end of the day, when I remember it's still true.
Dusk. When I remember and it hasn't gone.
The end of the day. That's the part.
odd.dialogue.conversations.noticed.expec: And they remember who said it.
Some mornings are harder than others.
Two of us in here now.
Since about the spring. It crept.
Spring. It accumulated rather than arrived.
No. Nobody's just said it before.
Mostly. There's a thing, but it's small.
Mostly fine. One thing. Not today.
You look like it, if you don't mind me saying.
You look it. That's all I'll say.
odd.dialogue.conversations.noticed.griev: Ah. You heard, then. We lost one of our own.
We lost somebody. The gap is everywhere.
You heard. Thank you for asking.
odd.dialogue.conversations.noticed.guard: Has the rain reached your side yet?
Then I'll still be here. Come anyway.
You'd best. I'll not send for anyone.
Something in the dark. Faster than me.
odd.dialogue.conversations.noticed.hurt/: In myself, fine. The rest of me, less so.
odd.dialogue.conversations.noticed.proud: Then I'll keep the next one.
I have been getting on with it.
A whole day. I'd not know what to do with one.
You mean it. Nobody's offered before.
Then I'll take it. Usefully spent would spoil it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.people.empath: Exhausting. They cross the lane when they see me coming.
It wears. Quietly. Nothing you'd see from outside.
odd.dialogue.conversations.people.encour: Don't. You've heard two minutes of it.
No. It isn't that simple and I'd rather not explain why.
...I could. Hearing it said makes it smaller.
odd.dialogue.conversations.people.first/: Good folk. I've assigned each of them a cloud. The mayor's is stubborn; the baker's is warm. It's a whole system, %1$s.
The neighbors are lovely once you learn their weathers. Some are drizzle, some are noon. All are welcome at my fence.
odd.dialogue.conversations.people.follow: Talking. Everyone here prefers a grudge.
odd.dialogue.conversations.people.fond.f: The baker. I'll deny it if it gets back to the miller.
The baker. She doesn't talk much either.
odd.dialogue.conversations.people.gossip: Then here it is. The miller's brother has been counting my firewood.
The miller's brother. My woodpile. That's all.
Since you'll keep it — the woodpile. He counts it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.people.respon: You want the specifics. Alright. This stays here.
odd.dialogue.conversations.people.resume: Less than I'd planned. Speeches don't mend.
'I've been avoiding you.' That was all of it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.people.shy/1: They're... a lot. Kind, but a lot.
odd.dialogue.conversations.people.shy/2: I like them best from my window.
odd.dialogue.conversations.people.shy/3: A lot. One at a time is better.
odd.dialogue.conversations.regrets.close: ...You didn't owe me that. It does help.
odd.dialogue.conversations.regrets.follo: Nobody has said that out loud before.
...That's better. Absolution I'd not have trusted.
Right. You didn't try to fix it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.regrets.forgi: ...You don't get to decide that. ...And yet something came loose.
It isn't yours to give. It landed anyway.
Kind. It doesn't reach the part that decides.
Kindly meant. Not far enough in.
No. It isn't yours to give me.
Right. We'll see if it holds.
odd.dialogue.conversations.regrets.resum: It has, a little. What you said stuck.
A little. Mostly the one sentence.
A little. You didn't tell me it was fine.
A little. Time does some of it.
Some. Being asked after does the rest.
I have, since you asked last.
I've thought about it. That's as far as I've got.
...You're right. A week of telling it.
I'll hold it. See if it comes from elsewhere.
The sensible line. Nobody draws it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.rumors.more/2: There's what's said, and what I think.
odd.dialogue.conversations.rumors.more/3: Go on. Better questioned than quoted.
odd.dialogue.conversations.rumors.privat: No. It's somebody's family, not a story.
That's exactly why I didn't say.
I said as much as I'm willing to.
Good. That's what I wanted from telling you.
Then I was right about you.
Thank you. I'll know by Thursday.
...You'd trade. Right. A rope round each other's ankle, then.
odd.dialogue.conversations.secret.respon: ...Alright. The 'famous' pie? The trader sells them.
Because you've never repeated a thing I've said.
Because you don't carry things to the square.
You've never passed anything on. I've been counting.
odd.dialogue.conversations.secret.resume: ...You asked after me, not the secret. You always were the right person.
...You asked after me, not the secret.
Me, not it. Nobody does that.
You wouldn't promise, and you've kept it anyway.
You refused to swear to it. That says more.
You gave your word and you've kept it. I checked, in my way.
You said you would and you did.
It's still between us, then. Good.
odd.dialogue.conversations.standing.mixe: That's why I gave you both.
You'll get the truth from me. Every time.
The warm half alone mends nothing.
Start with the ones who won't look at you.
It can be done. Twice, that I've seen.
odd.dialogue.conversations.standing.neut: You ask questions nobody else asks. I've not decided if that's good.
I'm still watching. That's not a bad sign.
odd.dialogue.conversations.standing.trou: You want it honest? There's a matter people haven't let go of.
Something's still being said. It sits between you and here.
There's a matter. That's as much as I'll put into words.
odd.dialogue.conversations.standing.unkn: Hard to read. Easy enough to like.
You listen more than you talk.
odd.dialogue.conversations.us.firstmet.a: ...You did. Not anything you said. Just that you stayed.
It wasn't a thing you said.
odd.dialogue.conversations.us.firstmet.t: You want the story? Go on, then. I'll tell it my way.
The story. It's short, and I remember all of it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.us.future.neg: ...Work it out. That's better than one of us giving in.
odd.dialogue.conversations.us.future.pro: That's fair. I'd rather that than a promise you'd resent.
odd.dialogue.conversations.us.happy.ask_: ...You want to know. Small things. You asking is one of them.
You asked. Nobody asks when things are fine.
Right. There's a list. It's short.
odd.dialogue.conversations.us.happy.reas: We will. I believe you when you say it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes/: Happy? The candles burn straight, the well says yes twice, and my odd little world makes sense with you in it. So: yes.
You're the one thing the omens and I agree on completely, %1$s. That's never happened before. Yes. Yes.
odd.dialogue.conversations.us.resume.adm: ...Honestly. Right. That's worth more than a better answer.
odd.dialogue.conversations.us.resume.ask: Ask me. I'd rather be asked.
Further than I'd have said out loud a month ago.
Not far. It hasn't gone backwards.
I think about it most evenings.
odd.dialogue.conversations.us.resume.hol: Then we're both still standing where we said.
odd.dialogue.conversations.us.resume.let: ...Rest. Aye. Not everything wants deciding this month.
odd.dialogue.conversations.us.resume.nam: Then name it. I'll hold you to it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.us.resume.say: It did. And you saying so is most of why.
odd.dialogue.conversations.us.worries.gi: ...Not today. That's permission I didn't know I needed.
You've let me not talk about it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.us.worries.he: ...Together. That's the part I couldn't do alone.
Right. Both of us on it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.village.ask_i: We've a smith. We've not got a road to reach him by.
The smith is fine. The road isn't.
A smith and no road. That's the shape of it.
odd.dialogue.conversations.village.follo: ...You'd put a hand to it? Opinions I get. Hands, no.
Then you're worth more here than most.
Careful. The mayor hears that and you're never free.
odd.dialogue.conversations.village.home/: %2$s sits at exactly the right angle to the sunset, which is why the bread rises here and nowhere else. Home, obviously.
I know which stones in %2$s are listening and which are just resting. It's a good village. The well vouches for it.
